name: constitution-circuit
description: CIRCUIT CITY Constitution Circuit netlist in TapeOut semantics. Single source of truth: this netlist is (1) simulated in JS, (2) ported to Solidity for on-chain parity, (3) drawn on the tapeout.net canvas and taped out on the CIRCUIT CITY Processor on X Layer.

semantics.nand: output = NOT(a AND b); inputs are pointers to element outputs
semantics.input: free input pin, value supplied per evaluation
semantics.tick: combinational evaluation order given by topo order; no feedback loops used in v1
semantics.burn: each element consumes exactly one NAND transistor token from the owning Processor at tape-out

inputs.name: citizenValid
inputs.meaning: actor is a registered Circuit Citizen in good standing

inputs.name: balanceEnough
inputs.meaning: proposed action amount <= actor balance (e.g. SELL amount <= ENERGY)

inputs.name: resourceEnough
inputs.meaning: resource (ENERGY) exists in the city ledger for this action

inputs.name: actionAllowed
inputs.meaning: action type is permitted and caller is authorized (not replayed, correct role)

notes: APPROVED = citizenValid AND balanceEnough AND resourceEnough AND actionAllowed, built purely from NAND (double-NAND as inverter). Required demo vectors: (1,1,1,1)->1 APPROVED; (1,0,1,1)->1^? -> (1,0,1,1) has balanceEnough=0 -> REJECTED, matching master prompt example 1101 -> REJECTED.
